items.text: Approaching 65 with retirement savings and looking at a fixed annuity? Ask a few questions first. How long is the surrender period, and what does early access cost? How is the rate set after the first years? Could you need this money in the next several years? We can walk through these with you and say plainly when an annuity does not fit. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146.
